title: Golfclub Zillertal Uderns
highlights: Contemporary 18-hole championship course in the wide floor of the Zillertal valley
Spectacular island green on hole 9 providing an unforgettable round highlight
Flat and easily walkable terrain featuring artfully sculpted water landscapes
Exclusive 5-star golf hotel and gourmet restaurant located right at the course
kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Zillertal in Uderns inspires golfers with a modern 18-hole championship course, expansive lakes, and an island green.
beschreibung:
First-Class Golf Resort in the Zillertal

Golfclub Zillertal Uderns is the first and only 18-hole golf facility in the Zillertal. Spanning more than 65 hectares, this par-71 championship course occupies the sunny, sheltered valley floor between Uderns and Fügen.

Sophisticated Water Hazards and Island Green

The course architecture is distinguished by gently sculpted mounds, manicured bunkers, and extensive water features. The highlight of the round is the island green on hole 9, located right in front of the clubhouse terrace, which demands pin-point precision on the approach. The surrounding mountains of the Zillertal provide a magnificent backdrop in every season.
